definitions: A polymer of formaldehyde, typically a white solid, used as a disinfectant, fumigant, and in the preparation of other chemicals.
A solid form of formaldehyde, often used as a convenient source of formaldehyde gas or solution.
examples: The lab technician handled the paraformaldehyde with care.
Paraformaldehyde is a common reagent in organic synthesis.
Fumigation with paraformaldehyde was effective against the pests.
